name: StarCraft-Vita
description: A VIBECODED dynamic recompilation port of StarCraft: Brood War v1.16.1 for the PS Vita
long_description: A PS Vita port of the original PC StarCraft / Brood War 1.16.1. It runs the unmodified Windows game through an x86-to-ARM dynamic recompiler (winx86, derived from Box86), with Win32, DirectDraw and DirectSound replaced by native Vita code.
